programme.title: La conjura de El Escorial

programme.title: Meet a Scientologist
programme.desc: Armando and Gabriella take the art of chocolate to the next level in their small-town shop in Sicily; the couple shares their journey, from falling in love at a bakery to the inspirations for creating some of the most extraordinary desserts.

programme.title: Destination Scientology
programme.desc: South Africa's remarkable and inspiring struggle for freedom is the backdrop of Johannesburg's flourishing society today; the Church of Scientology is part of the rich tapestry of cultures working together to make a better world for all.

programme.title: Inside Scientology
programme.desc: Experts race against time to safeguard Scientology's scriptures for future generations; an elite team develops new technologies to protect the source materials, while also drawing upon techniques of the past.

programme.title: Meet a Scientologist
programme.desc: British filmmaker and photographer Matt Brown recounts his journey, from the hardships of documenting life in war zones and extreme environments to his success working for international fashion magazines and the world's biggest brands.

programme.title: Destination Scientology
programme.desc: More than a group of suburbs in Los Angeles, the Valley is the epicenter of the entertainment industry with a mix of ethnicities that gives rise to a culture all its own; the church helps keep this unique community going strong.

programme.title: Signature Performances
programme.desc: Grammy Award-winning composer Mark Isham steps into the studio for the most ambitious project of his career; known for his work in jazz, New Age, film and television, he ventures into new territory, blending genres and pushing musical boundaries.

programme.title: I Am a Scientologist
programme.desc: A French graphic designer, a Romanian businesswoman and an American documentary filmmaker are a few of the people from around the world featured discussing how Scientology is helping them achieve the life they always wanted.

programme.title: The Way to Happiness
programme.desc: The acclaimed common sense guide to better living that inspired a worldwide movement is brought to life through dramatic and interwoven stories. People all over the world use its 21 precepts in their daily lives to achieve fulfilling.

programme.title: Voices for Humanity
programme.desc: Catalina Maldonado is bringing hope back to Ecuador, a country long caught in the middle of vicious drug wars and rising violence, by sharing the wisdom of The Way to Happiness. Her work's transformative impact is being hailed by civic leaders.

programme.title: Meet a Scientologist
programme.desc: Latin American comic Andrés López discusses growing up in war-torn Colombia, and how he won over audiences with his new form of stand-up comedy.

programme.title: Destination Scientology
programme.desc: Young visionaries from around the world come to Silicon Valley to pursue their dreams of becoming the next Steve Jobs or Mark Zuckerberg, and the Church of Scientology helps keep those dreams alive.

programme.title: I Am a Scientologist
programme.desc: A fitness coach in France, a motorcycle production company owner in Italy and an artist and illustrator in the United States are some of the people from around the world discussing the ways they've benefited with the tools of Scientology.

programme.title: Destination Scientology
programme.desc: With a history stretching back over 1,000 years, London, England, is both a city steeped in tradition and a trendsetting metropolis; the Church of Scientology bridges both aspects in its commitment to helping all in this unique world capital.

programme.title: Meet a Scientologist
programme.desc: Ian Espinoza is an architectural illustrator whose ability to convey a story through his art has helped projects around the world come to fruition; his beautiful illustrations have been utilized in the creation of many world-renowned landmarks.

programme.title: The Fundamentals of Thought
programme.desc: "Scientology: The Fundamentals of Thought" focuses on the basic processes and principles that define the primary architecture of how life works. Discover how to achieve a complete understanding of the mind, spirit and life.

programme.title: Meet a Scientologist
programme.desc: Lambros Malamas is a filmmaker prominent for capturing the timeless beauty of Greece; using drone videography, he showcases the country's stunning landscapes and ancient ruins and reveals some previously undiscovered historical sites.

programme.title: Voices for Humanity
programme.desc: Antónia Novák was first alerted to the problem of bullying in Hungary's schools when her son was the target of aggression. Today, she and her husband are leading a movement to strengthen moral values and create a more flourishing nation.

programme.title: I Am a Scientologist
programme.desc: A schoolteacher from India, a chocolatier from Mexico and an archer from the USA are some of the interesting people from around the world discussing how the tools of Scientology help them thrive in their everyday lives at home and at work.

programme.title: Dianetics: An Introduction
programme.desc: L. Ron Hubbard's all-time bestselling book on the human mind, "Dianetics: The Modern Science of Mental Health," inspired a movement spanning every continent on earth. Find out how painful experiences of your past can affect you in the present day.

programme.title: Meet a Scientologist
